compiled_fd_check.verdict: Actual ARM64 implementation and call ordering inspected; not inferred from strings or source alone.
compiled_fd_check.parent_bound: 0x1000134ec..0x100013500 calls sysconf(5/_SC_OPEN_MAX), subtracts 3 and unsigned range-checks against 0xffffe: accepts bound 3..1048576. 0x100013990..0x100013998 requires owned exec-status pipe below that bound before fork at 0x10001399c.
compiled_fd_check.stdio_check: 0x100014768..0x1000147a8 calls fcntl(fd,1/F_GETFD) on 0,1,2; rejects negative query and FD_CLOEXEC bit set.
compiled_fd_check.bounded_extra_scan: 0x1000147ac..0x1000147f4 checks every fd from 3 to bound exclusive. Owned status pipe must be queryable with FD_CLOEXEC set. Every other nonnegative query fails EBUSY(16); failed query is accepted only for EBADF(9), otherwise fails with observed errno.
compiled_fd_check.failure_path: fd_failure at 0x1000146bc emits 16-byte stage7 failure containing errno/offending fd then _exit(126).
compiled_fd_check.actual_child_call_order: close loop 0x100014b64..0x100014b84 skips only owned pipe; verify_child_fds called 0x100014b94 with exact parent bound; FD_CHECKED(stage9, bound, pipe) emit 0x100014b98..0x100014bb4; internal READY(stage10, pid, pid) emit 0x100014bb8..0x100014bd4; execve 0x100014be4. No intervening descriptor-opening calls; post-verification operations are stack record construction and emit/write before execve.
compiled_fd_check.parent_status_gate: Pty::setup 0x100012d38; bounded fragmented stream <=64 bytes at 0x100012e04..0x100012e28. Magic checked 0x100012ef8; stage9 accepted once before stage10 with bound/pipe equality at 0x100012f08..0x100012f3c; stage10 requires preceding stage9 and pid/group equality at 0x100012f44..0x100012f6c; EOF at 0x100012fd8..0x100013004 requires both records, no failure and no partial bytes.
compiled_fd_check.scope: Pre-exec descriptor inventory only, bounded by parent sysconf. CLOEXEC owned status pipe plus actual EOF is separate exec observation when later executed. No after-exec inventory, Mach-port inventory or native execution established here.
